title: Update TP and SL entry flow for single-first and paired submission
completion_summary: Added single-first TP/SL dialog flow with optional paired submission and Orderly-aware controller wiring.
acceptance_criteria: TP/SL entry UI defaults to submitting a single take-profit or single stop-loss order at a time.
Users can intentionally submit both TP and SL together from the same flow without bypassing validation.
Controller wiring passes the new native Orderly request shape without breaking existing message-bus interactions.
Validation steps include a deterministic manual or automated check for single TP, single SL, and paired TP+SL submission paths.
